description: This file defines the Token class, which represents a token within macro expressions used for substitution. The class includes an enumeration of token types (command, variable, value, comparison, group start, group end) and provides methods to access token properties and identify token characteristics, primarily used for parsing or interpreting macro expressions.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a token within a macro expression, with type and value, and utility methods for token analysis.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Token with its type and value.

methods.name: getKind
methods.description: Returns the type of this token.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value of this token.

methods.name: isComparison
methods.description: Indicates whether this token is a comparison operator (stub implementation returns false).

methods.name: isNegateComparison
methods.description: Indicates whether this token is a negating comparison operator (stub returns false).

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Indicates whether this token is an operator (stub returns false).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token for debugging purposes.
